Live: Trump boasts of record-high stock market after Republicans' midterm routUS Midterm Election 2026 Live Updates: The 2026 US midterm elections have dealt a major blow to President Donald Trump and the Republican Party, with Democrats reclaiming control of both the Senate and the House of Representatives, giving them a majority in Congress. The Democratic surge extended into traditionally Republican strongholds, with the party flipping at least seven Senate seats in states including Kansas, Iowa, Texas, Ohio, Maine, North Carolina and South Carolina, while retaining battleground seats in Georgia and Michigan. Democrats also flipped more than two dozen House districts, including several that backed Trump by double-digit margins in 2024. In gubernatorial races, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia, Amy Acton in Ohio, Rob Sand in Iowa and Gina Hinojosa in Texas defeated Republican rivals to capture party-held offices. The results mark a significant setback for Trump, leaving him with a Congress where Democrats can block his legislative agenda, reject his appointees and launch investigations into his administration during the final two years of his presidency. Stay tuned for the latest updates, including ground reports from our reporter Rohit Sharma and developments from major US media outlets.
